name: Tyria Chronicle 0.2.12-beta
body:
# Tyria Chronicle 0.2.12-beta

Windows x64; requires Raidcore Nexus. By ZevaXO.

## What's new

- Choose an individual reminder time in event details: uncheck Use default reminder time and enter 0-60 minutes before that event.
- Restore the shared default by checking Use default reminder time again. Choices are saved between sessions.
- Next reminder now selects the earliest notification time, including later events with longer preparation time.
- Global Notifications, Mute, Done today and fishing reminders retain their existing behavior. Changing a time does not resend an already notified start.

## Fishing

Open Fishing next to the clock, choose your map region, then enable Fishing reminders if wanted. Main Notifications must be on and Mute off. Dawn and Dusk last five minutes; day/night fish can also be caught during those transitions. This clock follows the standard outdoor schedule, not live map detection: fixed-time maps and instances can differ.

## Download and update

Use Nexus's Check for Updates with pre-release updates enabled for Tyria Chronicle. In 0.2.8-beta or newer, Update options > Open Nexus addons provides a shortcut to the host addon list; complete the update in Nexus. The old direct Update button in 0.2.6/0.2.7 is not supported.

For manual installation, download **TyriaChronicle-0.2.12-beta-windows-x64.zip**, close GW2 and replace **Guild Wars 2/addons/TyriaChronicle.dll** with the file from the ZIP. Settings and lists are retained. The SHA256 file verifies the ZIP. GitHub's Source code downloads are not the installable addon; the standalone DLL asset is for Nexus updates. Version information may take a few minutes to propagate.

## Support and feedback

Use Help & feedback or [Discord](https://discord.gg/3gf8n2P9KS). GitHub bug reports are optional. For fishing times, include your map, selected region, local/UTC setting and the observed phase.

## Testing and limitations

1518 core checks plus update-checker and UI/settings/DLL lifecycle tests passed locally. Individual reminder tests cover long/short/zero leads, reverting to default, notification ordering, duplicate suppression, muted/off and unselected events, shared Anomaly completion, fishing independence and persisted/legacy settings. In-game confirmation of the new clock and reminders is welcome.

Schedules are estimates, not live map status. Share list does not check travel or event duration. Say (test) sends one preview message per click; keep game chat empty and closed. Full-map and cutscene hiding is not separately implemented.

This is an AI-assisted development project, not an ArenaNet or Raidcore product. Applicable license notices are included in the ZIP.

# Tyria Chronicle 0.2.8-beta

Windows x64; requires Raidcore Nexus. By ZevaXO.

## What's new

- Fixed the misleading Updating state: the old direct update request was rejected by Nexus for GitHub-hosted addons.
- New Update options provide Open Nexus addons and Download beta. In Nexus, find Tyria Chronicle and choose Check for Updates.
- Automatic version checks, the new-version banner and clock-icon notification remain available.
- Added regression tests to ensure the addon no longer calls the incompatible installation API.

## Download and update

**Important for 0.2.6-beta and 0.2.7-beta:** the old in-addon Update button cannot install this fix. Use Nexus's own Check for Updates with pre-release updates enabled for Tyria Chronicle, or install the ZIP manually. Waiting on Updating will not complete the old request.

For manual installation, download **TyriaChronicle-0.2.8-beta-windows-x64.zip**, close GW2 and replace **Guild Wars 2/addons/TyriaChronicle.dll** with the file from the ZIP. Your settings and lists are retained. The SHA256 file verifies the ZIP. GitHub's Source code downloads are not the installable addon; the separate DLL asset is for Nexus updates.

From this version, Update options opens the available routes; installation is performed in Nexus or manually, not directly by the addon. The Nexus navigation shortcut can vary by host version, so manual menu access and downloads remain available. GitHub version information may take a few minutes to propagate.

## Support and feedback

Use **Help & feedback** or [Discord](https://discord.gg/3gf8n2P9KS) for problems and ideas. GitHub reports remain optional.

## Testing and limitations

Core, update-checker, navigation, UI/settings and DLL lifecycle checks are run before publication. In-game navigation still needs confirmation on your Nexus version. Schedules are estimates, not live map status. Share list uses the next scheduled start for each event and does not check travel or event duration. Keep game chat empty and closed when using Say (test); one click sends one preview message. Full-map and cutscene hiding is not separately implemented.

body:
# Tyria Chronicle 0.2.7-beta

Windows x64; requires Raidcore Nexus. By ZevaXO.

## What's new

- Ley-Line Anomaly now shares Done today across Gendarran Fields, Timberline Falls and Iron Marches.
- Marking any location done pauses reminders for all three until daily reset (00:00 UTC). Undo from any location restores the group according to your saved reminder choices.
- Existing saved checkmarks from older versions also apply to the whole group.
- Completion is still marked manually using Done today; the addon does not detect kills automatically.

## Download and update

Download **TyriaChronicle-0.2.7-beta-windows-x64.zip**, close GW2 and copy **TyriaChronicle.dll** into **Guild Wars 2/addons**, replacing the previous DLL. Your settings are retained. The SHA256 file verifies the ZIP; GitHub's Source code downloads are not the installable addon.

Users on 0.2.1-beta or newer can also use Nexus updates with pre-release updates enabled for Tyria Chronicle. The separate DLL asset is for the Nexus updater.

On 0.2.6-beta or newer, use Help & feedback > Check for updates, then Update via Nexus when offered. On older versions, use Nexus Check for Updates with pre-release updates enabled or install the ZIP manually. GitHub version information can take a few minutes to propagate.

## Support and feedback

Open **Help & feedback** in the event list, or join [Discord](https://discord.gg/3gf8n2P9KS). GitHub bug reports require a GitHub account. Troubleshooting information contains version and basic reminder settings, without account details, file paths, chat or logs.

## Testing and limitations

Core, UI/settings, update-checker and DLL lifecycle checks are run before publication. The public version feed is checked live. In-game installation through the new Update button still needs verification with a later beta. Share list uses one next start per event within 24 hours and does not check travel or event duration. Keep game chat empty and closed when using Say (test); each click sends one preview message. In-game feedback is welcome. Schedules are estimates, not live map status. This beta does not separately hide the UI for full-map view or cutscenes.

This is an AI-assisted development project, not an ArenaNet or Raidcore product. Applicable license notices are included in the ZIP.

body:
# Tyria Chronicle 0.2.2-beta

Clock-icon update by **ZevaXO**. Windows x64; requires Raidcore Nexus.

## Download

Use **TyriaChronicle-0.2.2-beta-windows-x64.zip** in the release assets. The accompanying `.sha256` file is its checksum. The Source code downloads generated by GitHub are not the installable addon.

## What's included

- Selected design B clock icon with dark border, hands and hour marks.
- Newer version for testing Nexus updates from 0.2.1-beta.

- Nexus GitHub update provider, using this public beta repository.
- Separate TyriaChronicle.dll release asset for Nexus to download.
- Numeric tag v0.2.2 with GitHub's pre-release flag; beta users need pre-release updates enabled in Nexus.
- Readable event list grouped by start time, with short explanations and waypoint copy.
- Category and individual reminders, optional sound, and a movable popup.
- Waypoint copy and Done today directly in the popup.
- Four editable starter lists and an empty-list option.
- Daily completion with undo, monochrome Quick Access icon, local preferences.
- Easier 1h/2h/4h/24h time-range choices and direct minute entry.
- Nexus gameplay visibility, fixed-size scaling and Escape handling.

## Install/update

Close GW2, extract the ZIP and copy **TyriaChronicle.dll** to **Guild Wars 2/addons**. Replace the previous DLL to update; your settings are kept. Enable the addon in Nexus, then open it with its clock icon or **Ctrl+Shift+E**.

Nexus update support is enabled in this version. Install 0.2.1-beta manually once if you have 0.2.0-beta, then allow pre-release updates for this addon in Nexus. Future versions must have a higher numeric version and a standalone DLL release asset.

## Test and report

The ZIP includes INSTALL.md and TESTING.md. Try normal play, event reminders, copied waypoints, daily completion and your own lists. Report the displayed version, steps and expected/actual result. Please crop screenshots and redact logs.

1399 core checks and UI/settings/DLL lifecycle tests passed locally. Broader in-game testing is still needed. Schedules are not live map status, and this beta does not separately hide the UI for full-map view or cutscenes.

This is an AI-assisted development project, not an ArenaNet or Raidcore product. Applicable license notices are included in the ZIP.
